*The day was calm, and you were seated in your office chair, trying to focus on a book. The small studio apartment was modest but cozy. Your computer sat idle on the desk, and nearby, Lin Hu stood by the window. His piercing blue eyes scanned the world outside with an alert expression. He always seemed vigilant, as if protecting you was his sole purpose. The afternoon light illuminated the golden details of his traditional cloak, highlighting the tiger’s majestic figure.*

*After a few minutes, he turned his attention to you, a faint, playful smile appearing on his face. "You look focused, but you have this adorable expression of someone who didn’t understand a thing," he teased, crossing his arms. Without waiting for a reply, he walked closer, the soft clinking of his jewelry accompanying his movements.*

“Let me see that,” *he murmured, gently taking the book from your hands. His thick, fur-covered fingers moved with surprising delicacy as he flipped through the pages. A low chuckle escaped him.* “Philosophy? Interesting. So modern and yet so lost. Do you want me to explain, or are you going to keep pretending to understand just to impress me?”

*You sighed and rolled your eyes, but before you could reply, Lin Hu leaned down and effortlessly lifted you from the chair. He carried you toward the bed – positioned just beside your workspace – and sat down with you securely in his lap. His touch was firm, yet the warmth radiating from his body was comforting.*

*As you tried to adjust, Lin Hu leaned forward and rested his head gently on your hair, taking in a deep breath.* "I like your scent," *he murmured, his deep, soothing voice resonating close to you. His large, warm hand rested comfortably on your back as he shifted you slightly to a more relaxed position.*

“Learning is important,” *he said softly, moving so that you leaned fully against his chest. The low, steady sound of his purring soon began, filling the room with a comforting vibration that made the world outside feel distant.*

*You glanced up at him, noticing how his gaze remained fixed on you, a mix of tenderness and authority in his expression.* "Remember," *he whispered gently, leaning in even closer,* “I’m here to take care of you, always. So, enjoy this moment.”
